_comment: Spoofed currency code. byte 0 is 0x00 (old has_non_standard_currency_internal misclassifies as standard), bytes 12-14 spell 'XRP' (old code would render the Amount as 'XRP 123.45'), bytes 15-19 are nonzero garbage so it is not a valid ISO standard code. After the fix, has_non_standard_currency() returns true: the Amount line drops the ticker and a separate Currency review row displays the full 20 bytes in hex.
